# Automatically Generated Wiring Cut-outs for Wiring Combs

The [wiring](Glossary_o_verdrahtungen.htm) combs used in wiring systems are realized in EPLAN as a [user-defined](Glossary_o_benutzerdefiniert.htm) rail on the basis of an extrusion outline. To be able to [route](Glossary_o_verlegen.htm) the [routing connections](Glossary_o_verlegeverbindungen.htm) through the wiring comb after inserting such an outline in the [layout space](Glossary_o_bauraum.htm), it was previously necessary to manually place a wiring cut-out on the wiring comb. When inserting a wiring comb, a wiring cut-out is now automatically inserted as well.

Prerequisite for this is that in the outline editor on the front of the wiring comb a mounting surface "Wiring comb front" was placed and on the rear of the wiring comb a mounting surface "Wiring comb rear".

![](../Pictures/Gui/ALL/benefit.png)Benefit:

Subsequent manual inserting of a wiring cut-out for the routing is not required anymore after a wiring comb has been placed in the layout space.
